What Verity Measures

Six pillars. Clearer decisions.

Pillar weights calibrate by organization type, initiative maturity, and investment context.

40%+
People

Sponsor engagement, team stability, cross-functional alignment, and stakeholder commitment.

25%
Process

Governance discipline, testing cadence, sprint velocity, and escalation patterns.

20%
Technology

Development activity, data quality, integration stability, and deployment readiness.

15%
Strategy

Alignment between stated priorities and observable resource allocation decisions.

~20%
Market

Customer need, competitive landscape, demand signals, and regulatory context.

~15%
Finance

Revenue trajectory, burn rate, unit economics, and cost structure.

Market and Finance are weighted contextually. For active enterprise programs, People, Process, Technology, and Strategy carry the primary weight.
